tailoring.headline: Business/System Analyst | Techno-Functional SAP Commerce Expert | Java, Spring, API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in gathering and analysing business requirements, writing user stories, functional specs and acceptance criteria. Proven record of designing and implementing REST/OCC APIs, micro-service integrations with PIM, ERP and MDM, and optimizing SQL queries. Strong agile experience (Scrum, Kanban) with Jira, Confluence and CI/CD pipelines (Docker, Kubernetes).

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Business/System Analyst
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Andersen’s focus on scalable enterprise-cloud architectures and AI-driven digital transformation. With 5+ years building SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep experience in end-to-end integration, API design and techno-functional analysis that aligns perfectly with your international projects.

bullets.label: Requirement Capture
bullets.text: Collected and refined business requirements for complex e-commerce solutions, translating them into clear user stories, functional specs and acceptance criteria for development teams.

bullets.label: Integration Design
bullets.text: Designed and implemented REST/OCC APIs and PIM-ERP data pipelines, ensuring seamless data flow across SAP ERP, MDM and third-party systems while collaborating with global technical stakeholders.

bullets.label: Process & Documentation
bullets.text: Modeled business processes, created detailed functional documentation and maintained traceability matrices, supporting QA, DevOps and architecture teams throughout release cycles.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery
bullets.text: Led sprint planning, backlog grooming and release coordination in Scrum/Kanban environments using Jira and Confluence, driving timely delivery of high-quality features.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holding a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available to start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Andersen’s success.

tailoring.why_company: Andersen’s reputation for delivering cutting-edge enterprise-cloud solutions to global clients resonates with my passion for techno-functional consulting. Your commitment to AI integration and modern architecture mirrors the innovative approaches I have applied in SAP Commerce projects for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am eager to join a fast-growing team where I can leverage my integration expertise and analytical skills to help shape robust, secure systems for your diverse clientele.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Andersen build secure, AI-enhanced enterprise solutions, using my proven SAP Commerce integration and business-analysis experience to drive value for global clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce developer and techno-functional analyst with 5+ years of experience. I’m keen to bring my integration and agile expertise to Andersen’s Business/System Analyst role. Could we discuss how I can add value?
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Business/System Analyst – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Business/System Analyst position at Andersen. With over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions, I excel in requirement analysis, API integration and agile delivery. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.
